## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

WatchApp — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/MainActivity.kt

## Trigger

The system back gesture (Wear OS swipe-to-dismiss / back button) — nothing observes it

## Today

`WatchRaceNavigator.backGestureEnabled` (WatchRaceNavigator.kt) is true
only while `current` is HOME or PREPARATION, false on MAIN, PROJECTION,
CONTROL and END. No caller reads it anywhere outside its own test file.
`WatchApp`, the root composable in MainActivity.kt, dispatches on
`navigator.current` to render each screen but installs no
`BackHandler` of its own at that level; the only `BackHandler` in the
file is nested inside the HOME branch, guarding the history overlay
(`BackHandler(enabled = showingHistory) { showingHistory = false }`),
and is unrelated to race pages. As a result the system back gesture is
left to its default handling on MAIN, PROJECTION, CONTROL and END,
letting an accidental gesture during a race leave the running race.

## Expected

`WatchApp` installs a `BackHandler` that reads
`navigator.backGestureEnabled` on every destination, not only HOME's
history overlay: the gesture is left to step back where the property
is true (HOME, PREPARATION), and is consumed without effect where it
is false (MAIN, PROJECTION, CONTROL, END), so an accidental gesture
during a race no longer moves the app off the race pages.
